records.name: Mandate-bound obligation treasury
records.financial_problem: Treasury must pay approved obligations unattended, never pay fabricated ones, and keep committed cash from being spent elsewhere
records.customer: Crypto SMEs and DAOs paying vendors and contractors in stablecoins
records.agent_responsibilities: Read invoices, match to mandates, choose timing, reallocate envelopes, fund reserve, redeem, reconcile, escalate
records.asset_management_role: Allocates between reserve and operating accounts and across envelopes; optional surplus placement (IDEA-074)
records.onchain_workflow: Redeem one-use exact obligation mandates from reserve; period-capped envelope payments from operating; one-way reserve top-ups; owner bulk revoke
records.security_model: Agent key holds gas only and can only redeem; route M: MetaMask caveats (exactExecution, limitedCalls 1, timestamp, redeemer, erc20PeriodTransfer, allowedCalldata, nonce); route Z: Safe with Roles 2.1.1 and Delay 1.1.1 adding the veto lane; loss certificate shown live
records.closest_competitor: Request Finance (approvals to payments); AgentsPay (offchain caps); Cleared (registry, agent sessions on roadmap); PACE (binding)
records.novelty_hypothesis: An AP agent whose entire authority is owner-signed, onchain-enforced mandates, with a published conditional loss bound tested by public attackers; integration-level
records.dependencies: Smart Accounts Kit or Safe/Zodiac on chosen testnet; test token; two RPCs
records.mvp_scope: Reserve and operating accounts; three obligations; two envelopes; one token; one chain
records.demo_and_evaluation: Payroll-reserve demo (R001 F03): vendor bill refused; injection, duplicate and address-swap attempts fail onchain; red-team drain stays under displayed bound
records.change_note: Audit A N1 integrated with Audit B restorations
